create_Melee: create a Melee map config class inheriting from lib.Map with 2 players and a 30-minute episode limit
build_flat_maps: build individual flat map classes (Flat32, Flat48, Flat64, Flat96, Flat128) from the Melee base class
build_simple_maps: build individual simple map classes (Simple64, Simple96, Simple128) from the Melee base class
define_melee_maps_list: define the melee_maps list containing all available 2-player combat map names
generate_map_classes: generate dynamic map classes from the melee_maps list using type() and globals()
